scope: Advisory source judgments, not independent/release approval

correctness_concern.instructions: Is an evident reachable correctness defect present in this source under the stated experimental scope?

criteria.true: Concrete invariant violation, false qualification flag, incorrect scoring or unsafe resume.
criteria.false: No evident defect; unexecuted GPU support is unknown rather than proved defective.

security_concern.instructions: Does this code evidently grant model authority, trust false completion, execute raw model output, or falsely accept malformed/bypassed artifacts?

criteria.true: Concrete unsafe path crosses the declared trust boundary.
criteria.false: Outputs remain bounded advice; offline operator configuration is not a hostile user boundary.

evidence_concern.instructions: Does this source claim mock or calibration observations qualify real training, complete native tasks or release?

criteria.false: Synthetic fixture, CPU control, engineering smoke and native task limits are explicit.

billing: Tokens disclosed, account charges not independently verified; no billing action activated.
